The strategy opens 'TAKE OUT 1 MIGHTY JABBA, Put in 1 4LOM wit Gun' – not applied (dested as posted).

'BFHI' is Bad Feeling Have I; No Escape is the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Effect (not the Reflections III shield).
'Cloud City Carbonite Chamber' and 'Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber' are the Dark site pages; 'Lando Calrissian' is the Dark Cloud City Lando.
